name: archdisc-forge
description: ArchDisc Forge — Archie-first parametric MCAD on OCCT

scripts.electron:dev: cd frontend && npx vite --port 3000 & sleep 3 && npx electron . --dev
scripts.electron:build: cd frontend && npx vite build && npx electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.electron:build:win: cd frontend && npx vite build && npx electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.forge:kernel:test: node forge-kernel/test/smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/inertia_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/bench_100k.js && node forge-kernel/test/part_features_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/thicken_surface_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/knit_surface_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/trim_surface_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/sheet_metal_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/sheet_flat_pattern_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/mold_split_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/pipe_route_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/weldments_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/assembly_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/assembly_hierarchy_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/native_binding_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/native_engines_smoke.js && node forge-kernel/test/native_analytic_face_inventory.mjs && node forge-kernel/test/native_vs_occt_core.mjs && node forge-kernel/test/directedit.mjs && node forge-kernel/test/native_unify_smoke.mjs
scripts.forge:kernel:build:native: cd forge-kernel && ../node_modules/.bin/cmake-js configure --out build-native --CDCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release --CDFORGE_NATIVE_BREP=ON && ../node_modules/.bin/cmake-js build --out build-native --parallel 10
scripts.forge:e2e:features: npx playwright test e2e/push-32-sketch-on-face.spec.js e2e/push-34-edge-picking.spec.js e2e/push-35-datum-planes.spec.js e2e/push-36-multibody.spec.js e2e/push-37-assembly-mates.spec.js --workers=1 --reporter=line
scripts.gate: npm run forge:kernel:build && npm run forge:kernel:test && npm run forge:bridge:test && npm run forge:unit && cd frontend && npx vite build && cd .. && npm run forge:e2e:features
